design_philosophy: Warm, authentic Italian premium feel with editorial elegance. Avoids clinical pure white, relying on warm cream tones, stark black for contrast, and the brand's signature sage green for interaction and freshness.

buttons.primary: bg-[#7FA9A8] text-[#FDFBF7] hover:bg-[#6C908F] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1A1C18] text-[#1A1C18] hover:bg-[#1A1C18] hover:text-[#FDFBF7] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none px-8 py-4

cards.product: bg-[#F5F2EA] border border-black/5 hover:border-[#7FA9A8]/30 transition-all duration-300 group overflow-hidden cursor-pointer
cards.dashboard_widget: bg-[#F5F2EA] border border-black/5 p-6 rounded-sm shadow-sm

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5 transition-all

modals.product_detail: bg-[#FDFBF7] rounded-none sm:rounded-sm max-w-4xl w-full p-0 overflow-hidden

animations.page_transition: framer-motion fade-up with duration 0.6s and ease [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]
animations.hover_effects: Subtle scale-up for images inside cards (group-hover:scale-105 duration-700 ease-out)
animations.micro_interactions: Staggered fade-in for menu list items

hero_background.usage: Landing page hero section background with bg-black/40 overlay

story_section.usage: Background or side image for the 'Notre histoire' section

menu_pasta.usage: Restaurant menu category header or featured signature dish

grocery_olive_oil.usage: Epicerie category header or featured grocery product

key_features_guidance.checkout: Use Shadcn forms. Clear summary of order with VAT separated (2.6% takeaway, 8.1% delivery). Checkbox for marketing opt-in.
key_features_guidance.reservation: Use Shadcn Calendar. Grid of time slots (15m intervals). Honeypot field (hidden input) to prevent spam.
key_features_guidance.dashboard: Hidden at /Angel/dashboard. Use Shadcn Tabs for horizontal navigation across sections (Orders, Reservations, Menu, etc.). Dense data layout (clear, function-first, high contrast black text on warm cream).
key_features_guidance.product_modal: Large 2-column layout (image left, options right). Shadcn form components (Checkbox for addons, Stepper/Input for quantity, Textarea for comments).

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='add-to-cart-btn'
accessibility.contrast: Ensure #7FA9A8 has sufficient contrast against #FDFBF7. When placing text on #7FA9A8, use #FDFBF7 or #1A1C18.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the exact color hex codes provided in this JSON.
Build the UI prioritizing customized Shadcn components (strip Vercel look, adapt to the warm/flat print style using surface and background colors).
Use the exact logo URL provided.
For the admin dashboard, ensure it's accessible directly via /Angel/dashboard route.
Implement the Swiss VAT logic accurately (2.6% for takeaway, 8.1% for delivery) in the cart/checkout calculation.
